response.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(inv.avg_cost) AS avg_product_cost, AVG(inv.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(inv.ratio - overall.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio_above_overall FROM inv, overall WHERE inv.ratio > overall.avg_ratio
